audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers reads Jax/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Jax, which contradicts the packet chart (Urgot,Urgot,Skill,Urgot,Jax,Urgot,Urgot), the 47.36% win rate, and the whys text on the same page (whys[0],[1],[3],[5],[6] all describe Urgot winning; whys[4] describes Jax's level-6 window).
audit.why: Urgot out-trades pre-3 with autos plus Corrosive Charge slow, W Purge ranked at 4-5 machine-guns Echoing Flames, and at two items his tank stats plus Fear Beyond Death (execute) beat a solo Jax duel. Jax owns only the level-6 Grandmaster's Might window.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Urgot, Urgot, Skill, Urgot, Jax, Urgot, Urgot in both layers as one atomic group, ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is called "Grandmaster at Arms" in whys[4], spikes[2].text, mid and wants.you[2]. That is Jax's title, not the ability.
audit.why: The ability is Grandmaster's Might — the full layer already uses that name in phases[4].why, so the page contradicts itself.
audit.corrected: All four content-layer occurrences renamed to Grandmaster's Might. Spike ordering kept: Urgot spikes at W ranks (4-5), 6, and tank items; Jax spikes at 3 (Counter Strike), 6, and Trinity Force.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain is described only as 'his engage' with no cooldown, so the advice 'engage when it is down' has no timer attached. Counter Strike's own 17s rank-1 cooldown is never stated either.
audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 (14s at rank 5) and shields Urgot on the charge; Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1, so if Jax burns E first he is naked for longer than Urgot's flip is down. The concrete numbers are what make the sequencing rule usable.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and tldr now state Disdain's 16s rank-1 cooldown and key the Q-leap to that window.

audit.why: Disdain is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; the fix above adds the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.suspectNames flags wants.you[0] 'Hold Counter Strike' as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Counter Strike is the correct name of Jax's E. This is a false positive in the near-miss detector.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, his tank stats and Fear Beyond Death's execute out-grind your side-lane duel. Take the fight with a teammate, never solo.

edits.before: E his W-shred — Q-leap in when his flip is down. Jax wins by trading around Urgot's Disdain and cashing the pattern: e his Purge and out-scale his shred.
edits.after: Hold Counter Strike through his Purge storm, then Q-leap in on Disdain's 16-second cooldown — that stun window is the only trade Jax reliably wins in this lane.

edits.before: His engage. Dodge it, then Q-leap in. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s at rank 1 — bait it, then Q-leap in while it is down.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' instant Armor/MR plus the every-third-hit on-hit wins the duel here, so all-in at 6 while his Disdain is down.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's instant Armor/MR plus the every-third-hit on-hit wins the duel, so all-in at 6 while his 16s Disdain is down.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' instant Armor/MR burst plus the every-third-hit on-hit is your one clean all-in window before his tank items take over.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's instant Armor/MR burst plus the every-third-hit on-hit is your one clean all-in window before his tank items take over.

edits.before: Force the all-in at 6 with Grandmaster at Arms' resists up before his percent-HP tank scaling overtakes you
edits.after: Force the all-in at 6 with Grandmaster's Might resists up before his tank scaling overtakes you

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tilt back to him as he ranks W (Purge): the channel locks onto you and rapid-fires the shotgun legs, and your own growing HP only makes the percent-max-HP procs hit harder, so a stand-still fight favors his sustained DPS. Your one good window is level 6: pop Grandmaster at Arms for the instant Armor/MR and the every-third-hit on-hit, hold Counter Strike for his autos and W, and all-in while his E (Disdain) is down. That is the cleanest kill you will get all game, so set it up on his Disdain cooldown and do not waste it scaling.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt back to him as he ranks W (Purge): its cooldown drops 12/9/6/3/0, so the channel locks onto you and rapid-fires Echoing Flames almost on demand, and a stand-still fight favors his sustained DPS. Your one good window is level 6: pop Grandmaster's Might for the instant Armor/MR and the every-third-hit on-hit, hold Counter Strike for his autos and W, and all-in while his E (Disdain, 16s) is down. That is the cleanest kill you will get all game, so set it up on that cooldown and do not waste it scaling.
